title: BillingPlanChargePackagePricing
description: Pricing based on a package which simple offers, a base rate, with some amount of charges per bundle. This enables scenarios such as charging $0.00 for the first 3 users, but $10 for the next.

amount.description: The amount to charge per package.

free_units.description: The total free units included with the package.

package_size.description: The package size that is billed, for example if (1) then charged each, if (10) will be charged per 10 units.
